text:
auditor_matt: Morning. For the ISO audit we need evidence bundle showing RBAC change approvals + KMS key usage for the incident on 2025-12-14 22:30-23:30 UTC. Deliverables: logs, approval artifacts, and a reproducible export recipe. Who can own?

nina: I can take the log exports. we'll capture KMS Admin and API usage, role assumption events, and the ticket trail. tagging @ryan-oncall for the incident notes.

samir: devops-bot created ticket #SEC-6021 :white_check_mark:

devops-bot: Ticket SEC-6021 created, priority: urgent, assignee: nina.

ryan-oncall: adding incident runbook excerpt now. note: the responder noted a suspicious re-encrypt operation around 22:44 UTC.

auditor_matt: please include both service principal and human actor traces. we need to see which principal triggered Decrypt/ReEncrypt and any subsequent role escalations.

nina: rough export plan: (a) Splunk: cloudtrail KMS events + STS AssumeRole window; (b) okta_audit for SSO approvals; (c) ticketing export from Zendesk (approval thread + approver ID); (d) incident notes.

samir: Splunk savedsearch: "iso_kms_rbac_bundle_v2". query I will run:```
index=cloudtrail eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=ReEncrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey) earliest=1768235400 latest=1768239000 | dedup eventID | table _time, eventName, userIdentity.type, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.keyId, recipientAccountId, eventID, sourceIPAddress
```

nina: for STS correlation:```
index=auth_logs event=AssumeRole | eval session=coalesce(userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName, userIdentity.arn) | table _time, session, principalType, eventID, requestParameters.roleArn
```

ryan-oncall: incident_notes.md includes timeline + mitigations. i'll redact internal IPs but leave service CIDR tags. add redaction_manifest.txt describing redaction rules.

auditor_matt: we expect reproducibility: include the savedsearch names, job IDs, and exact CLI commands you used for export.

tara-compliance: add control mapping to ISO Annex A clauses: A.9 (access control), A.12 (operations logging), A.10 (cryptography). map each artifact to clause and provide a 2-line rationale. auditors prefer a CSV for this.

nina: packaging checklist: - kms_events.ndjson - sts_assumerole.ndjson - okta_logins.ndjson - zendesk_approval.pdf - incident_notes.md - redaction_manifest.txt - control_mapping.csv - manifest.sha256 

samir: export commands I'll note and include in reciperepo/export_cmds.txt. example: `splunk search "savedsearch=iso_kms_rbac_bundle_v2" -output json > kms_events.ndjson`

auditor_matt: how will you prove integrity of the bundle after upload?

nina: we'll tar+gzip and produce a sha256 and also sign it with our internal GPG key (key id 0xA11C0D3). commands: `tar czf iso_sec6021_bundle.tgz <files>` then `sha256sum iso_sec6021_bundle.tgz > iso_sec6021_bundle.sha256` and `gpg --armor --sign --local-user 0xA11C0D3 iso_sec6021_bundle.sha256`

ryan-oncall: for extra chain-of-custody, we capture the S3 put event and include object metadata: x-amz-server-side-encryption, x-amz-meta-uploader, and version id.

auditor_matt: ok. also need proof that keys were ephemeral per policy. include KMS rotation/alias timeline and any CreateGrant/DeleteGrant events.

nina: adding `eventName=(CreateGrant OR RetireGrant OR RevokeGrant OR CreateKey OR ScheduleKeyDeletion OR RotateKey)` to the savedsearch. will include `list-aliases` output `aws kms list-aliases --key-id <id>` per key.

samir: FYI I'll redact user emails in okta_logins.ndjson but add `okta_redaction_map.csv` with hashes for mapping.

ryan-oncall: vuln triage: i've added `vuln_context.md` if any CVEs were relevant during that hour; no known exploit found in our timeline.

auditor_matt: can you also provide evidence of reviewer identity for RBAC approvals? a SAML assertion id or okta event id with timestamp is fine. avoid sharing raw tokens.

tara-compliance: include a screenshot of the ticket approval page with timestamp (png) and a PDF export of the approval thread. note retention rules in `retention_note.txt` (180 days for audit artifacts).

nina: ETA: exports run now, expect upload in ~45 minutes. I'll attach Splunk job IDs in the bundle.

samir: upload flow: put to `s3://evidence-redwood/iso/sec6021/` with SSE-KMS, presigned PUT generated with `aws s3 presign`. will share presign to auditor_matt via secure chat.

auditor_matt: please also include the Splunk job JSON (search metadata) and savedsearch definition so we can rerun exactly.

nina: included: savedsearch name + job id 8812345097 + job.json.

devops-bot: Reminder: SEC-6021 handoff meeting 2025-12-15T09:00Z.

ryan-oncall: bundle uploaded. presign sent to auditor_matt. manifest sha256: e5d8b9c3f4a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6

auditor_matt: checksum verified. I'll run validation and report back. thanks for the quick turnaround.

tara-compliance: noted retention exception and legal hold details included. closing for now, will reopen if auditor requests more.
